articles.title: AI+ Power 2026 Explores How AI Drives Real Business Value
articles.summary: Hong Kong's premier AI exhibition returns June 4-5, 2026, featuring major tech companies like Microsoft, Adobe, and BytePlus to showcase enterprise AI applications and bridge the deployment gap.

articles.title: State Privacy and AI Law Updates Across US States
articles.summary: Colorado repeals and replaces its AI Act, Georgia enacts new chatbot legislation, while California and New York advance multiple AI-related bills in latest regulatory developments.

articles.title: Therapists Increasingly Adopt AI for Session Recording and Notes
articles.summary: A growing number of mental health professionals are using AI tools to record therapy sessions and generate clinical notes, raising discussions about privacy and efficiency in healthcare.

articles.title: Meta's Layoffs Highlight AI-Driven Corporate Restructuring
articles.summary: Meta announces significant layoffs while increasing AI investments by up to $10 billion, reflecting broader tech industry trend of using AI efficiency gains to offset workforce reductions.

articles.title: Pope Leo to Address AI Ethics in First Major Document
articles.summary: The Vatican announces Pope Leo's first in-depth document will address artificial intelligence challenges and ethical considerations, marking significant religious engagement with AI issues.

articles.title: Salesforce CEO's AI Strategy Sparks Industry Discussion
articles.summary: Marc Benioff's vision for a future with reduced engineering hiring due to AI capabilities generates buzz about the transformation of software development roles.

articles.title: AI Reveals Hidden Magnetic Chaos in Electric Motors
articles.summary: Researchers develop physics-based AI framework that explains temperature-dependent magnetization reversal, potentially leading to more efficient electric motors and energy savings.

articles.title: TSMC Faces First Real Competition as AI Reshapes Chip Industry
articles.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor faces unprecedented competition from Intel and Samsung as AI-driven demand transforms the semiconductor manufacturing landscape.

articles.title: Apple Loses Chip Supply Dominance to Nvidia and Google
articles.summary: The AI boom has disrupted traditional chip supply dynamics, with Apple now competing against other US tech giants for semiconductor resources.

articles.title: AI Reshapes Global Semiconductor Manufacturing Conference Agenda
articles.summary: The 2026 Compound Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology Conference shifts focus to AI-driven manufacturing processes and next-generation chip technologies.

articles.title: US National Labs Seek Newcomers for AI Supercomputing
articles.summary: As the chip industry prioritizes AI applications, US national laboratories are turning to new semiconductor companies for advanced supercomputing capabilities.

articles.title: Data Center Chip Market Projected to Reach $687B by 2032
